## Request Summary

Briefly describe the axiom or result you would like to see added to Scaffold.

## Mathematical Statement

Provide the informal mathematical statement of the result.

## Source Reference

Include full citation:
- Author
- Title
- Edition/year
- Chapter/section
- Theorem/Lemma number
- Page number (if available)

## Suggested Lean Statement

If you have a suggestion for how this should be formalized in Lean, provide it here.

## Why It Matters

Explain why this result is important and what downstream results it would enable.

## Existing Alternatives

Are there existing results in Scaffold or mathlib that could be used instead?
